# Wular Sports

> Handcrafted Kashmiri Willow cricket bats — hard tennis, soft tennis & leather ball. Made in Srinagar, Kashmir, India.

Wular Sports is a handcrafted Kashmiri Willow cricket bat manufacturer based in Srinagar, Jammu & Kashmir, specializing in hard tennis bats. Founded by Moin Wani in 2015 (online since 2025). Every bat is made from naturally seasoned (1–3 year) Kashmir willow, hard-pressed for durability, fitted with a Singapore cane handle, and shipped fully knocked and oiled — ready to play out of the box. Free delivery across India, 1-year warranty, 7-day returns, and cash on delivery.

## Shop by category

- [Hard Tennis Bats](https://wularsports.com/hard-tennis-bats): Legacy 1.0, Legacy 2.0, Bahubali — hard-pressed Kashmir willow for hard tennis ball cricket
- [Soft Tennis Bats](https://wularsports.com/soft-tennis-bats): AK-47 honeycomb scoop, 820–950g
- [Leather Cricket Bats](https://wularsports.com/leather-cricket-bats): Grade A+ Kashmir willow, 5–12 grains

## Products

- [Legacy Edition 1.0](https://wularsports.com/product/legacy-edition): Grade A Kashmir willow hard tennis bat, 950–1050g, 48–52mm edges, ₹2,799
